testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1106:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the View ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the Part | View custom target is empty ✔ When the user opens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu ✔ And the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in All Commands ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part | View target ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ And the user reopens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu ✔ Then the Part | View target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in All Commands ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the View ribbon remains visible
